result.citation: San Diego Mun. Code § 98.1103 (Ord. O-21955 N.S.); see also id. §§ 98.1102, 98.1104(a)
result.official_quote: It is unlawful for a person to sell, license, or otherwise provide an algorithmic device to a landlord. (b) It is unlawful for a landlord to use an algorithmic device to set rental rates or occupancy levels for residential rental property.
result.note: Added the 'Ord.' label and moved the related sections into a 'see also id.' cite with the § 98.1104(a) pinpoint, and replaced the quote taken from the draft proposal (D076, O-2025-107) with the adopted code text in D074, which also makes attorney's fees available to a prevailing landlord, not only a tenant.
